paper_id: CC-Tuning_ A Cross-Lingual Connection Mechanism for Improving Joint Multilingual Supervised Fine-Tuning__oa_W4412944828
title: CC-TUNING: A Cross-Lingual Connection Mechanism for Improving Joint Multilingual Supervised Fine-Tuning
motivation: LLM因英文训练语料主导导致多语言能力失衡，现有方法仅在数据层做隐式对齐
problem_framing: 将跨语言对齐从数据层推到隐层，通过融合英/非英前馈激活实现显式跨语言连接
key_insight: 非英语输入可从英语激活的融合中获益，且中间层捕获的泛化知识最具价值
method_signature: CC-TUNING：训练时融合英/非英前馈激活加Decision Maker选择，推理时用Transform Matrix替代平行语料
evaluation_criteria: 6基准22语言NLU/NLG任务的Accuracy和ROUGE-L指标对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: +EN设置下CC-TUNING性能反而下降，因EN2EN连接偏离跨语言目标；实验仅在两个模型验证
evidence_for_taste: overlook the potential for deeper, latent-level cross-lingual interactions
cross-lingual connection becomes an EN2EN connection
underscores CC-TUNING's alignment with its motivation
the middle layers may capture more valuable and generalized knowledge
thinking_moves: 从数据级对齐转向隐层激活级对齐
引入可学习的Decision Maker实现自适应层选择
通过消融实验证明组件必要性而非假设
EN2EN场景性能下降反而验证方法与动机的契合
借鉴FFN存储事实知识的发现定位前馈激活的作用
